claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ketorolac is a non-cytotoxic NSAID (COX-1/COX-2 inhibitor) that at 2.5 uM is not expected to kill cancer cells; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, unrelated to its COX inhibition.
